title: Grace: the gift no one earns
note: Rebuilt on 2026-11-26 from the Bible Explorer film of the same slug. New wording, same facts: each claim is in the old film's captions or its 'differ' note, whose sources are in docs/work/elite/explorer-ledger.md. Scripture is the Berean Standard Bible, checked against client/public/bible/text/ by film/tools/write-script.py.

lines: A wage is owed. A gift is not. The Bible's word for the gift is grace: the free and undeserved favor of God, who gives sinners what they could never earn and forgives what they could never repay.
For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

scripture.text: For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

lines: Jesus told of a landowner who paid those who had worked one hour the same as those who had worked twelve. The early workers grumbled, and he answered that he had wronged no one.
Or are you envious because I am generous?
Grace offends anyone who is keeping count.

scripture.text: Or are you envious because I am generous?

lines: Grace is not God grading on a curve. He didn't wait for sinners to put things right.
He paid the debt himself, while we were still his enemies. The cross is what the gift cost.

scripture.text: But God proves His love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

lines: So salvation is received, never achieved: by grace, through faith, not by works.
Faith is not the one good deed that earns it. Faith is the empty hand that takes what is given.

scripture.text: For it is by grace you have been saved through faith, and this not from yourselves; it is the gift of God, not by works, so that no one can boast.

lines: Does that make sin safe? Paul heard the question and answered it at once.
Shall we continue in sin so that grace may increase? Certainly not!
The grace that forgives also teaches. Good works are not the root of salvation. They are its fruit.

scripture.text: Shall we continue in sin so that grace may increase? Certainly not!

lines: And grace doesn't stop at the door. Paul pleaded three times for a weakness to be taken away, and it was not. He was given this instead.
My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.
Grace enough for the day, and God's power at its clearest where ours runs out.

scripture.text: My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.

lines: The gift is meant to travel. People who know they have been forgiven, forgive. People who know that everything they have was given, give.
In the church no one has anything they did not receive.

scripture.text: Be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other just as in Christ God forgave you.

lines: All Christians confess that salvation is God's gift, received by grace and not earned.
They differ on how God's grace and the human will relate, and on how grace is received: by faith alone, or by faith with the sacraments and the life of the church. This film takes no side.
Grace is the gift that no one earns.
